name: Example: daily search activity
description: Summarises yesterday's completed searches per user from the _audit index. If the step fails, an email goes to you@example.com: change the address before you turn the job on.

steps.name: Searches per user
steps.spl:
index=_audit action=search info=completed
| stats count AS searches, avg(total_run_time) AS avg_seconds BY user
| sort - searches
